notes.title: 🎌🎮 We’re at TGS! — Live Demo (Day 1)
notes.content:

Booth: Hall 11, stand C62.

Goodies: stickers and stamp marks for players, and T‑shirts for those who beat the claw challenge (limited).

Booth photo plus first community impressions throughout the day.

notes.title: 🚀🎮 Trailer + Demo Launch

🚀🎮 Trailer + Demo Launch (Steam)


Today we launch the playable demo and drop its trailer! It features four pillars of the vertical slice: the fishing mission, Decoration Mode (magnet), diorama view, and board mode for collecting/unlocking. If you like what you see, add us to your Wishlist and share your first impressions. 💗


Trailer

[previewyoutube="7uBl9USCZug;full"][/previewyoutube]

Available today
Fishing mission: a short, clear loop to learn the basics (this is our baseline for future missions—tell us how it feels and how we can improve it).

Decoration Mode (magnet): move/place objects with an energy‑particle “tether” and 3D dust on landing.

Diorama view: stroll through “Marble Station” and enjoy the details.

Board mode: collect and unlock objects for your diorama.

Collectibles: 40+ items (urban props, plants, signage).

Support: Steam Deck, gamepad + keyboard (basic mapping).

Go to the game’s Steam page.

Click the “Demo” button to download.

Share feedback in this post or on our Hub/Discord. 💌


Tokyo Game Show
Dates: September 25–28.

Location: Hall 11, booth C62.

Drop by for stickers and—if you beat the claw challenge—shirts (limited stock).

Our demo single is out now: “Clawby Bubble Gum”. Listen here → 🎧 Smart link

Add us to your Wishlist and share the trailer with a friend.

notes.title: 🧊 Demo Freeze — What’s in the TGS build
notes.content:
🧊 Demo Freeze — What’s in the TGS build 
Hi! We’re entering a feature freeze for the demo we’ll release on September 15 on Steam and also take to Tokyo Game Show. Here’s the final scope, what stays out to keep stability, and how you can help with your feedback at the event.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/1a1333c97247608a6d0e5e958e451cc23d827b57.gif"] 
Included in the demo (TGS build)
 Fishing mission: a short, clear loop to learn the basics.

 Decoration Mode (magnet): move/place objects; energy lines and 3D dust on landing.

 Diorama view: walk through the Japanese diorama (Marble Street) and enjoy the details.

 Board mode: collect and unlock objects for the Japanese diorama (Marble Street).

 Initial collectibles: 40+ items across urban props, plants, and signage.

 Controller support: gamepad + keyboard (basic mapping).

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/c6f40c44fe7c317ccfef0f358c05ec16b0f5a78f.gif"] 
Out of scope (for now)
 New dioramas.

 Additional missions beyond fishing. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/209a03a57e565bd5d766944803544867ec609800.gif"] 
How you can help
 Try the four modes and tell us what reads in ~10s and what doesn’t.

 Leave quick impressions (timing, clarity, accessibility) at the booth or in the comments.

 Add us to your Wishlist and share the demo with someone who might enjoy it.

 
Roadmap
 Pre‑TGS: mini trailer of the demo with fishing, decoration, diorama view, and board.

 Day 1 of the show: live post from the booth + first impressions.

 Post‑show: mini postmortem + patch with demo adjustments.

 

Note: scope may receive minor tweaks up to show day; we prioritize stability and a clear loop read. Thanks for being with us!

notes.title: 💫🧲 Devlog #03 — Decoration Mode + VFX (Demo Sep 15)
notes.content:
💫🧲 Devlog #03 — Decoration Mode + VFX (Demo Sep 15)
Heads-up: a new demo lands on Sep 15, featuring this Decoration Mode plus more.

Today we’re debuting the Decoration Mode. A magnet lets you grab objects and place them anywhere, with an energy-particle tether. When they land, a 3D dust VFX plays. The system saves each object’s position and you can reset the diorama anytime.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/4a97344ee947a81a03feef03ee1a1119e4508375.gif"]
New
 Decoration magnet: attract and move objects freely; place them precisely.

 Energy particles: a visual “tether” follows the grab and movement.

 3D dust on landing: particles spawn on impact for weight and detail (integration WIP).

 Save & reset: the diorama remembers positions; button to restore the default layout.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/44803631fe51e631f26de76879c7b383cdcc4b69.gif"]
How it works
 Position Clawby over the object you want to move.

 Press A to lower Clawby and stick the object to the magnet.

 Adjust rotation with the controller bumpers.

 The system auto-saves your composition; you can reset anytime.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/aa7b96b8abcab06845e8476fa5d716d32dcd73b8.gif"]
VFX & detail
 Energy lines are soft and readable at mid-distance.

 3D dust triggers on impact to reinforce object weight.

 Duration/size/density tuned to avoid visual noise.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/16eb681b85b966cb860694166c3794902f0db074.gif"]
Bugs & fixes (demo status)
 Edge-case collisions to avoid clipping on release.

 Pivot pass on some props for a cleaner initial grab.

 Persistence checks in heavy scenes (WIP).
How you can help
 Would you like a per-object reset in addition to full reset?

 Which category should we prioritize: plants, furniture, signage, or “treasures”?
Roadmap
 Sep 15: new demo build — fishing mission, Decoration Mode, diorama view mode, and the board mode for collecting/unlocking.

 Next post: 🧊 Demo Freeze — what’s in the TGS booth build.

Note: everything is WIP; names and art may change as we iterate.

notes.title: 🧱✨ Devlog #02 — From blockout to high poly (Japanese diorama)
notes.content:
🧱✨ Devlog #02 — From blockout to high poly (Japanese diorama)


Hello! In this devlog we go from blockout to model (and bake) using real props from the Japanese diorama: the vending machine, the mini‑truck and the signage. Goal: correct scale and clear mid‑distance readability.


3‑step process Blockout: big shapes, silhouette, pivot and scale using real‑world refs. Model: clean bevels and surface continuity for readable highlights. Bake & low: projection checks to avoid artifacts.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/9fca9f743d7fdabc55f6b748b961d56738cb617c.png"]
Bugs & Fixes (demo status) Normal fixes after bake on curved surfaces (WIP). Simplified collisions for smooth navigation in the diorama.How you can help Vote the next prop to deep‑dive: vending / mini‑truck / signage / bench. Share texture references (photos or ideas) in the comments.Roadmap Next: Art Drop #2 — we’ll show special TGS art (shirts, stickers, exclusive pieces) and more game concept art.
Note: everything shown is WIP; art and names may change as we iterate on the demo.

notes.title: 🎏🏮🐕 Art Drop #1 — Japanesse Diorama for the new demo (40+ new objects)
notes.content:
🎏🏮🐕 Art Drop #1 — Japanese diorama for the demo (40+ unlockable items)
Hello! Today we’re sharing a cozy look at the concept art for our official demo diorama—a small Japanese street corner made to stroll, decorate, and discover details.

This set comes with over 40 unlockable items (WIP): plants, lanterns, benches, signs, vending machines, boxes, poles, shop signs, and little surprises.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/d047206ca586076e2ff38e6372cb2ebdaabebe9b.png"]
New “Japanese neighborhood” diorama: street, small plaza, charming facades. Everyday life: a courier, neighbors, and a curious dog. Some elements interact with the world so the scene feels alive. Tiny truck and urban props to set the vibe.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/733efc43f79acb75962da08830407278fd7762f0.png"]
Diorama & collectibles (WIP) Decoration: planters, shrubs, lanterns, benches, fences, cones. Commerce: signs, awnings, shop boards, illustrated menus. Urban: streetlight, road signs, mailbox, bins, boxes, barriers.How you can help Tell us which items should be unlockable on day one. Which interaction excites you most—the dog, the vending machine, or the truck? Share your favorite references (photos or ideas) in the comments.
Note: everything shown is WIP; names and art may change as we iterate on the demo.
